Class Mappings.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.map.Mappings.Builder
Enclosing interface:
Mappings
public static class Mappings.Builder extends Object
Assembles a Mappings instance from mapping sources and named functions. Sources are dispatched to a MappingLoader by file extension, or by a format id where the caller names one, so formats may be mixed freely; load order is the order in which they are declared here. A builder is spent once build() has been called, so what it returns cannot be changed afterwards.
Since:
6.0

  • Method Details

    • function

      public Mappings.Builder function(String name, Function<String,String> function)
      Registers a function that an Unmatched.Computed fallback can refer to. Functions must be registered before the source that refers to them is loaded.

    • allowOverride

      public Mappings.Builder allowOverride(boolean allowOverride)
      Allows a later mapping source to silently replace a mapping of the same name loaded earlier. Off by default: a duplicate mapping name is a load-time error.

      public Mappings.Builder load(String location)
      Loads a mapping source, in whichever format its file extension identifies.
      Parameters:
      location - a URL, or a classpath: location such as classpath:/META-INF/map/atna2fhir.mapping.xml

    • load

      public Mappings.Builder load(String location, String format)
      Loads a mapping source in a format named explicitly, for a source whose name does not identify one: 
      Mappings.builder()
    .load("https://tx.example.org/ConceptMap/gender", "conceptmap-r4-json")
    .build();
      Parameters:
      location - a URL, or a classpath: location
      format - a format id such as xml, yaml or conceptmap-r4-json, or null to dispatch by file extension
